prompt: Which movie musical produced a song that was inspired by poetry from an American poet, who was born a week after Queen Victoria?
answer: **Fame** (1980). Its song **“I Sing the Body Electric”** was inspired by Walt Whitman’s poem of the same title. Whitman was born on May 31, 1819—one week after Queen Victoria’s May 24 birth.
